description: Things take a momentous shift when a bold & loving village girl, Malli, crosses paths with a doting father and his 6-year-old daughter who yearns for a mother's love. Join the family's journey through the nuances of love, affection & parenthood. Malli – early access only on Sun NXT.

A thought-provoking show that brings together voices from different walks of life to debate contemporary topics every week. Through insightful arguments, balanced perspectives, and lively discussions, it informs, entertains, and inspires viewers.
